title: Suno Ye Awaaz Wa Hussaina ki Zarre Zarre se Aa Rahi Hai
body:
Suno ye awaaz wa hussaina ki zarre zarre se aarahi hain
Har ek lamha khudayi saari Hussain ka gham mana rahi hain
Sada-e-Akbar pa sue maqtal,Hussain tezi se jarahe hain , magar zaeefi khadam khadam par gira rahi hain utha rahi hain
Alam ke hain sath sath har dam toh aisa mehsoos horaha hai, ke ab bhi mazloomiyat pa gazi ki mashq aansou baha rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain –e-bekas ke sath Akbar hain aur Abbas-e- bawafa hain, aba mein dulhe ki laash lekar baraat maqtal se aarahi hai
Qabar kisi qafele ki aane ki jab kabhi bhi watan mein aati, gareeb sughra yehi samajti sawari baba ki aarahi hain
Hai Karbala meinye kounbacchakejis pa teere sitam chala hai, watan mein sughra ye kiski yaado mein khali jhoola jhoola rahi hai
Rabab ke chhe(6) mahine wale ka mareka hain ajeeb dekho, ke zulm aansou baha raha hai toh tishnagi muskura rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pukari Zainab tadap tadap kar kaha ho Abbas aake dekho, qadam qadam par meri Sakina tamache zalim ke kha rahi hai
Rasan mein jakde hain sab ke shaane Sakina tera gala bandha hai, jo hain aziyat kaho gi kaise ke saans ruk ruk ke aarahi hai
Nahi hai Zainab ke sar pa chadar rasan mein bazoo bandhe hue hain, Ali ki beti ka hai ye aalam jo aaj darbar jarahi hai
